notes.title: Significant bug fixes
notes.content:
[h1][b]🔧 Major fixes and improvements:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized network code, which fixes the problem with high ping on clients.
[*] Fixed the behavior of the ghost when it could not appear after a player loses.
[*] Fixed a bug where all players would remain on the level without the ability to exit after a defeat.
[*] Fixed out-of-sync objects in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed a bug where opening a computer by the host led to its opening for all players at the same time.
[*] Fixed a problem with saving settings that could lead to resetting certain parameters.
[*] Fixed an important bug on the Office level where in some places it was impossible to pick up documents, which made it impossible to complete the mission.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ghost could call the elevator and end the mission prematurely.
[*] Fixed the ability of the ghost to collect documents.
[*] Fixed localization errors and minor textual inaccuracies.
[/list]
[h2][b]➕New features and content:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a soundtrack for the ghost to scare other players.
[*] Added 3 new character skins
[/list]
Overall, the update is aimed at improving gameplay and stability.
